name: warm-market
title: Warm Market
summary: Friendly consumer brand: warm serif headlines, rounded sans body, earthy palette and soft surfaces. For food, retail, wellness, travel, local businesses and lifestyle apps.
imagery: Warm, natural-light photos of real products, food and people at work; rich textures, no cold studio shots.
rules: Headlines in Literata 500-600, sentence case, can run large; body in Nunito 400 16 px, lineHeight 1.5.
Use soft as a background band for every other section and surface for cards.
Radius 16 px for cards and images, pill shapes (999) for buttons and tags.
One accent for actions, prices and small badges; text on it uses on-accent.
Photos are large and generous; let one image bleed to the frame edge per page.
Shadows only very soft (blur 24 or more, opacity under 10 %) and only on floating elements.
No gradients, no neon colours, no stark black.
